svg.title: AWS: endpoint to evidence report
svg.desc: Terraform-defined, not deployed. Route 53 resolves the endpoint, an HTTPS ALB reaches an ECS Fargate application, RDS reserves identity, S3 retains originals, GuardDuty gates reads, a separate relay publishes to Amazon MQ, and a leased worker invokes Bedrock privately. Fenced RDS state is read by the UI.
svg.text: Terraform-defined · not deployed · business steps match local execution
DNS does not carry the résumé
6 Worker validates and commits through RDS
7 Read through the same HTTPS entry
React → ALB → nginx/Django → RDS → JSON status/report → React
Polling overlaps 3–6. The browser never calls the model directly.
Failure returns a safe category; retries never become an invented zero score.
Solid: request/work and its documented response. Dashed: DNS lookup or status reads.
S3 + GuardDuty are in the document view; networking/access/operations have a supporting view.
